reviewer: runtime agent, independent of the auditor/interface author

checks.basis: The auditor uses Python standard-library JSON, gzip, SQLite, hashing and byte comparisons, with no producer, service, cache or reference-verifier imports.

The exact original freeze manifest hash is admitted and every used workflow, file manifest, entry/module and PNG byte sequence is checked against its frozen size/hash before independent program-revision construction.
The reader rejects nonempty unapplied WAL/journal data and opens the complete closed SQLite file in immutable read-only mode; database integrity and exact relevant row counts are checked.
Accepted source, report, artifact full-byte digest/identifier, committed run identity and producer implementation agree. A report or stored metadata cannot replace the actual full BLOB bytes.

Each transcript exchange advances exactly one ordered durable request row; index, project, request ID, operation, terminal state, canonical request SHA and exact full response serialization agree, and trailing rows/requests are rejected.
A gzip readline limit of 8 MiB plus one byte bounds allocation before decoding or searching for a complete newline. Duplicate JSON members and nonfinite JSON tokens are refused.
Frozen materialized request and budget dictionaries use exact canonical JSON comparison. Booleans and integral floats cannot impersonate required integers through Python equality.

Offsets, lengths, next offsets, consumed work and minimum counts require bounded native nonnegative integers; truncation requires an actual Boolean; elapsed time is finite and nonnegative and original clocks/deadline are finite.

Every stored request engine and the committed run implementation bind to the producer artifact identity. Every response preserves the explicit original effective/source/host/default limits, request/source identity and deadline interval.

All original artifact requests are the exact frozen sequential requests; every returned decoded range equals actual stored bytes, with exact offset/length/next-offset/truncation semantics and complete identity.
A complete success requires the exact successful empty EOF, exact past-EOF refusal and all original PNG ranges. Extra requests after the prescribed workflow are rejected.
Only the explicit allow-incomplete option permits a prefix, and complete_frozen_loop remains false until all artifact bytes, EOF/refusal and PNG bytes have actually occurred.

The report retains original database and compressed/raw transcript hashes and sizes, request/response chain hashes, source closure and producer identity; original database/transcript hashes are checked unchanged after observation.

All 11 preserved cases replay with expected outcomes at exact f95b9d2 bytes; nine previously accepted coherent invalid records now refuse for their intended admission predicate, the original valid control passes, and the oversized line refuses before unbounded allocation.
The independent historical complete 48-exchange control passes 1,221 checks; the actual current capacity prefix of 10,002 exchanges passes 250,075 checks and remains explicitly incomplete.

preserved_cases.after_refusal: AssertionError('Every frozen chunk request uses actual decoded sequential offset')
AssertionError('Every durable request is bound to its actual producer implementation')
AssertionError('Every actual request retains frozen allocation, inherited defaults and implementation')

retained_attempt_classifications: Independent probes02 left a SQLite connection open, so the nonempty WAL precondition masked intended predicates. That harness preparation failure is retained; probes03 explicitly closes each copy and is the valid before witness.
Preserved-witnesses-after01 had a driver SyntaxError before invocation and made no auditor or input runs. It remains retained; after02 is the actual successful exact-input replay.
scope_limits: This review verifies the listed offline receipt auditor, not torque physics, independent source numerical proofs, the implementation truth of every reported primitive, or a complete integrated release.

The 48-exchange complete control belongs to its recorded historical implementation; it is not a final-basis A08 claim. The 10,002-exchange current capacity control retrieves only 10,000 of 2,447,148 bytes and does not execute EOF or PNG reads.

The auditor observes and hashes an actual closed SQLite file. It does not reconstruct that original physical SQLite file from a transcript. Any final ZIP omission of that original database must be explicit and retain the original hash, full transcript, retrieved artifact, source closure, report/run metadata and auditor receipt.

A future full workflow on different implementation bytes requires a fresh actual store/transcript and fresh auditor execution. Existing prefix/historical audit success cannot stand in for those requests.
